articles.title: Uniti Group adds 1,100 miles to its South-Central U.S. fiber network
articles.mainIdea: Uniti Group adds 1,100 miles to its South-Central U.S. fiber network
articles.summary: TipRanks: Uniti Group adds 1,100 miles to its South-Central U.S. fiber network. Uniti Wholesale announced an expansion initiative of its dark fiber network across the South-Central United States, anchored by a 20-year customer contract with a total contract value of over $500 million. The deployment adds 1,100 route miles of ultra high-capacity fiber and upgrades space and power at over 20 colocation sites to link Tier-1 markets with AI hubs. articles.title: Uniti Group price target raised to $7 from $6 at Barclays
articles.mainIdea: Uniti Group price target raised to $7 from $6 at Barclays
articles.summary: TipRanks: Uniti Group price target raised to $7 from $6 at Barclays. Barclays raised the firm’s price target on Uniti Group (UNIT) to $7 from $6 and keeps an Equal Weight rating on the shares. The firm adjusted ratings and targets in the real estate investment trust group as part of its 2026 outlook. It sees the most upside in apartments, storage, and single family rentals in 2026, and is least positive on cold storage and retail.
